issue.title: Fix parallel-suite flakes in stall watchdog and slow-tools snapshot
issue.description: Discovered during just check after splitting src/sase/bead/project.py. The 28-worker fast suite failed tests/ace/tui/util/test_stall_watchdog.py::test_watchdog_keeps_hitch_and_stall_state_machines_independent and tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_slow_tools.py::test_agents_slow_tool_calls_fold_levels_png_snapshots. The watchdog passed immediately in an isolated pytest rerun; the snapshot passed immediately through its proper just test-visual lane with 26 workers. Investigate shared timing/render contention so the default parallel suite is reliable.

payload.entry: Closed during open task-bead audit on master d462e97bb. The exact watchdog node tests/ace/tui/util/test_stall_watchdog.py::test_watchdog_keeps_hitch_and_stall_state_machines_independent passed 3 consecutive focused runs. just test-visual passed 393 tests with 1 skipped, including tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_slow_tools.py::test_agents_slow_tool_calls_fold_levels_png_snapshots, and the standard just test lane did not fail either named node.

payload.close_reason: no longer reproducible on current master
